westinghouse_timechecks_1904.webm.annotations: Westinghouse factory shift workers punching time clocks. Note: initial 4.5s contains LOC copyright slate; use clips starting at 4.5s or later. Strong vertical line cadence.

westinghouse_welding_1904.webm.annotations: Dramatic radial sparks and glowing steel ring welding. High dynamic range makes this prime material for particle generation and audio-reactive thresholding. Bypasses first 5s slate.

edison_butterfly_1894.ogv.annotations: Annabelle Whitford performing the Butterfly Dance at Edison Black Maria studio. Fabric wings with hand-painted tinting cues. Clean from 3.8s onwards.

edison_serpentine_1894.ogv.annotations: Fluid silk swirls creating organic spiral vortices. Excellent source for curl noise particle vector field advection.

edison_sneeze_1894.webm.annotations: Fred Ott's Sneeze (1894), one of the earliest copyrighted motion pictures. High keypoint density on facial features for cellular automata pixel matrix treatment.

oscilloscope_pulse.ogv.annotations: Analog CRT oscilloscope traces. Geometric Lissajous orbits and high-voltage pulse sweeps suitable for wireframe and vector overlays.

crystal_microscope.ogv.annotations: Microscopic polarized light footage of chemical crystal nucleation and growth. Complex branching geometries match the harmonic pad layer.

sunflower_timelapse.ogv.annotations: Timelapse recording of sunflower blooming spiral. Mathematical golden ratio seed placement ties directly into the generative geometry.

muybridge_horse_1887.gif.annotations: The classic 1887 photographic plate 'The Horse in Motion'. 16 sequential camera exposures showing biomechanical flight phase.

grammatizator_v4.mp4.annotations: Prior rendered version 4. Can be sampled for second-generation hybrid composites, glitch feedback loops, and 3D wireframe snippets.
